CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking processing/attention to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate for red) is identified and paired with an explicit origin/representation field (organization/access) for the same referent/time; the origin field separately attributes status.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change claim tied to the same identified content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colored items by coordinate for named referents (p0/current/... ).

D.rationale: Origins/representation metadata are separately attributed to the same content referents, distinguishing content identification from its representation/status.

O.rationale: Explicit organization/presentation metadata (origin/represented_time) and a display-layout statement describe how content is represented and presented.
